verse.text: No, O people, the LORD has told you what is good, and this is what he requires of you: to do what is right, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God.

video.title: What Does God Want from You? | Micah 6:7-8 | Our Daily Bread Video Devotional

reflection: Being a good man or dad isn't complicated, but it is costly: do right by your family even when it's inconvenient, extend mercy when your kids mess up, and stay humble enough to admit when you're wrong. Micah 6:8 strips away the noise and gives us a simple checklist to run our days by — justice, mercy, humility — the same three things our kids are watching us model every single day. You don't need a grand gesture; you need to show up faithfully in the small, ordinary moments and let those three words shape how you lead your home.
